newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kvaerner unit wins orders for FIM 1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner unit wins orders for FIM 1 bln.

text.p: Kvaerner Pulping -- part of Norwegian Kvaerner group -- said in a statement on Monday it had won boiler orders for a total of over one billion markka from south-eastern Asia, Europe and the U.S.
"The aggregate value of the orders is over one billion markka," it said.

Three boilers would be delivered to a Sumatran pulp and paper plant, one boiler would go to to Norske Skog's Colbey paper plant and two boilers to a client in the U.S. which has previously ordered 12 similar boilers, it said.
